regimeSub: Warsh Jackson Hole speech imminent as stagflation mix (3.3% CPI, 1.5% GDP, -23k NFP) pins Fed at 3.63%.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole speech Aug 23 (WSJ) → markets positioned for hawkish hold guidance; July FOMC kept rates at 3.63% despite 3.3% core PCE overshoot vs 2% target
US stagflation confirmed: Q2 GDP 1.5% miss (Jul 30 Advisor Perspectives), July NFP -23k (Aug 7 CNBC), July retail -0.4% MoM (Aug 14 Census) → consumer cracking while inflation sticky
JGB selloff deepens (Aug 18 Asahi) → BOJ hike bets firm as Takaichi fiscal concerns mount; USDJPY 158.8 testing MOF intervention zone with BOK Deputy Kwon Aug 21 urging balanced rate approach
KOSPI retraces to 6802 from 6901 highs as Samsung/SK Hynix HBM rally consolidates → USDKRW at 1381 as won strength complicates BOK Aug rate call per Korea JoongAng (Aug 20)

headline: Fed Chair Warsh heads into Jackson Hole with stagflation trap fully sprung—3.3% inflation, 1.5% GDP, negative payrolls—while markets await guidance on whether the Fed hikes into weakness or tolerates above-target inflation.
